_comment: Edit freely. 'entities' are never translated. 'asr_corrections' fix common mis-hearings (lower-case keys). 'abbreviations' are translated with the given Hindi meaning.
_pronunciations_comment: Audio only: how the Hindi voice should SAY a name. Use it only when the voice gets a name wrong: tests showed ElevenLabs reads English names in Latin letters correctly, and Devanagari re-spellings made some worse (Asterisk -> 'S-Risk'). ALL-CAPS short forms (HR, PDF, OTP) are spelled out automatically.
